uric: “Beauty has no effect upon uric acid that I’m aware of,” he sighed, contemplating the round pane opposite, through which the sky and sea showed blue.
urinal: Moreover, urinal and foecal smells surged upward from the garbage-littered bottom of the court which her window faced.

Emma Lou waited downstairs in the dirty marble hallway where she was stifled by urinal smells and stared at by passing people, waited for about ten minutes, then, in answer to his call, climbed one flight of stairs, and was led into a well furnished, though dark, apartment.
uriel: To Uriel watching the progress of planetary history from the sun, the one result would be just as much of a coincidence as the other.
